# apple_subscription_retention_message_offer (Resource)

Presents one retention offer with a subscription's retention message. Use one resource per offer. Destroying the resource stops presenting the offer and leaves the offer itself alone. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<retention_offer_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_retention_message_offer" "stay" {
  subscription_id    = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  retention_offer_id = apple_retention_offer.stay.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `retention_offer_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of one of the subscription's retention offers, e.g. `apple_retention_offer.example.id`.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_retention_message_offer.stay
  identity = {
    subscription_id    = "6446452616"
    retention_offer_id = "7710428835"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `retention_offer_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention offer.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <subscription_id>/<retention_offer_id>
terraform import apple_subscription_retention_message_offer.stay 6446452616/7710428835
```
